summary: Comprehensive testing of Shift Management P1 features completed successfully. Backend: 31/31 tests passed (100%). Frontend: All 14 features verified working. Three P1 features (Clock-in/out UI, Custom Shift Presets, Drag-and-drop) are fully functional.

- Timesheet with date range filter working
- Summary cards display (Today's Shifts, Week Hours, Active Team, Pending Requests)
- Tabs: Shifts, Timesheet, Requests all visible
- Calendar view shows shifts with draggable='true' attribute
- List view shows shifts with Clock In/Out buttons
- Presets button opens 'Manage Shift Presets' dialog
- Dialog shows 'Current Presets' section with existing presets
- Custom preset 'Night Shift' (23:00-07:00) visible with delete button
- 'Create New Preset' form has: Name, Icon, Start Time, End Time, Color
- 'Quick Select Shift Type' section shows presets
- Clicking preset auto-fills Start Time and End Time
- Date, Member assignment, Role, Department, Color, Notes fields present
- 'Make this a recurring shift' checkbox available
- Created shift for today (Mar 4) assigned to Admin User
- 'Clock In' button (green) appears for user's own shifts on today
- Clock In triggers API and shows 'Clocked in successfully' toast
- After clocking in: 'Clock Out' button (red) appears with 'Active' badge
- GripVertical icon visible on shift cards for drag indication
- Time Tracking section shows period dates
- Admin User entry visible with 0h worked, 1 entry
- 'Clock in/out buttons appear on today's shifts' description present
